In this contribution we have discussed and identified the affected requirements in existing specifications of TS 38.133 and TS 36.133 due to introducing RedCap. Based on the list of affected requirements in Table 1 (TS 38.133) and Table 2 (TS 36.133), following observations and proposals are made: Observation #1: Significant RRM impact in 38.133 due to new RedCap specific requirements. Observation #2: RRM impact in 36.133 due to new RedCap specific inter-RAT LTE requirements. Proposal #1: RedCap specific requirements are introduced in new subsections of each relevant section in TS 38.133. Proposal #2: RedCap specific requirements are introduced in new subsections of each relevant section in TS 36.133.

[2] (ran4_cr_chunks 38.133, sim=0.6134)
[CR CR3569r1 for 38.133] Reason for change: Corrections are needed related to Inter-RAT measurements for RedCap. Summary of change: Following changes are made: In several occurences, the term Tidentify_CGI, E-UTRAN is corrected. Title of clause 9.4.7.2 title is reformatted. In clause 9.4A.4.1, applicability of requirements for 1Rx and 2Rx RedCap UE is corrected. Editorial errors are removed related to 1Rx and 2 Rx RedCap requirements. Consequences if not approved: Wrong applicability of requirements for 1 Rx and 2 Rx RedCap UE. Inconsistent spec.

However, there are still some open issues such as power class, operating band and REFSEN. In this contribution, we provide some discussions on FR1 RedCap UE requirements.
